body:
Track 8 (`accel`), milestone 1 `accel-kws`: a quantised MLP for keyword spotting on Speech Commands v0.02 (10 keywords + unknown), mapped to a serial-MAC RTL engine checked bit for bit against an integer NumPy reference (40 of 40 swept configs, 200 test clips each), with Yosys generic-gate area, modelled energy and an always-on power comparison with `ambient-wearable`.

Checked: 13 unit tests pass, `python site/build.py` prints ok, citations for Warden 2018, Hello Edge 2017 and Jacob et al. 2018 verified on arXiv. Flagged in the README: Horowitz energy constants typed from memory and not re-checked; dataset taken from a third-party Hugging Face mirror (original host unreachable); everything is stylised.
